extName.message: cici — Claude in Chrome device ID
extName.description: Extension name, shown in the Web Store and on chrome://extensions.

extDesc.message: Tells you which Chrome profile each UUID in Claude Code's browser picker belongs to, starting with this profile's bridgeDeviceId.
extDesc.description: Web Store description, 132 characters or fewer.

htmlLang.description: BCP 47 tag for the language of this catalog; goes straight into <html lang>. chrome.i18n.getUILanguage() is the wrong answer because it reports the browser UI language, which disagrees with the rendered text whenever Chrome falls back to default_locale. Update this when adding a locale.

appTitle.description: Product name in the popup header.

loadingHint.message: Scanning the browser profiles on this computer.

cancelScan.description: Button on the loading screen. The way out when one read hangs.

needFileAccessTitle.description: Title shown when the file access toggle is off.

needFileAccessWhy.message: The bridgeDeviceId lives inside your Chrome profile folder. Reading that file needs "Allow access to file URLs" turned on.

howToStep1.message: Open this extension's details page with the button below.

howToStep2.message: Turn on "Allow access to file URLs".

needFileAccessNote.message: Flipping that toggle makes Chrome reload the extension, so this popup closes the moment you do. You do not need to restart the browser — just open the popup again and it works.
needFileAccessNote.description: Note that the toggle reloads the extension.

copyUrl.description: Button that copies the chrome://extensions URL.

urlCopyHint.message: The popup closes when you press the button. You can also copy the address and paste it into a new tab.
urlCopyHint.description: Help text next to the copy button.

currentProfile.description: Section heading above the current profile card.

otherProfiles.description: Section heading for the remaining profiles.

foundProfiles.description: Section title for the list when the current profile could not be identified; it includes the current one.

badgeCurrent.description: Badge on the current profile card.

deviceIdLabel.description: Label above the UUID. Do not translate.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Please select the text and copy it yourself.

copyDeviceIdAria.description: Screen reader name for the current profile's UUID button.

copyOfAria.description: Screen reader name for a list row's copy button.

unnamedProfile.description: Shown when the profile name could not be read.

notPaired.description: The Claude extension is installed but has no bridgeDeviceId.

notPairedHint.message: Connect this browser to Claude Code once from the Claude extension and an ID is created.
notPairedHint.description: Help text for the not-paired state.

claudeNotInstalled.message: The Claude extension is not in this profile
claudeNotInstalled.description: No such folder under Local Extension Settings.

claudeNotInstalledHint.message: Install Claude in Chrome in this profile and its ID shows up here.
claudeNotInstalledHint.description: Help text for the not-installed state.

profileUnreadable.message: Could not read this profile folder
profileUnreadable.description: Shown when the profile listing failed, so installation cannot be determined.

profileUnreadableHint.message: The folder could not be read, so whether Claude is installed here is unknown. See the notes below.
profileUnreadableHint.description: Help text for the unreadable state.

pairingUnknown.message: Cannot tell whether this profile is paired
pairingUnknown.description: The Claude extension folder is there but its storage could not be read. Must not be conflated with "Not paired yet".

pairingUnknownHint.message: The Claude extension's storage could not be read, so it may already be paired. Try "Scan again".
pairingUnknownHint.description: Help text for the pairing-unknown state.

selfNotFoundTitle.message: Could not tell which profile this is
selfNotFoundTitle.description: Title when the nonce round trip failed.

selfNotFoundHint.message: Pick yours from the list below. This can happen when a profile folder cannot be read.
selfNotFoundHint.description: Help text when the current profile is unknown.

noProfilesTitle.description: Title when profile enumeration came back empty.

noProfilesHint.message: Check that your browser is installed in its default location. Browsers started with a custom --user-data-dir cannot be found.
noProfilesHint.description: Help text for the empty state. This screen only appears after file URL access has been confirmed to be on, so it must not tell the user to check that toggle: flipping it only reloads the extension and fixes nothing.

scanCutShortTitle.description: Shown when the budget expired or the user stopped the scan before any profile was counted. A different state from "none found".

scanCutShortHint.message: The scan stopped while counting profiles, so there are no results. Try "Scan again".
scanCutShortHint.description: Help text when the scan was cut short.

noOtherProfiles.description: Shown when the current profile is the only one.

statusScanned.message: Scan finished. The current profile is $PROFILE$, and there are $COUNT$ other profiles.
statusScanned.description: Summary read out when the scan finishes.

statusScannedNoSelf.message: Scan finished. The current profile could not be identified; $COUNT$ profiles were found.

errorTitle.description: Title of the fatal error screen.

errorHint.message: Press "Try again". If it keeps failing, copy the details below and report them on the project page.
errorHint.description: Help text on the error screen.

retry.description: Retry button on the error screen.

copyErrorDetails.description: Button that copies the diagnostics on the error screen.

warnSelfDetect.message: Could not determine the current profile: $DETAIL$

warnScanTimeout.message: The scan ran out of time, so some profiles may be missing. Try "Scan again".
warnScanTimeout.description: Shown when the overall budget expired or the user stopped the scan.

warnStorageUnavailable.message: chrome.storage.local is unavailable, so the current profile cannot be shown. manifest.json needs "storage" in "permissions".
warnStorageUnavailable.description: Shown when the storage permission is missing.

warnNoExtensionContext.message: chrome.runtime.id is unavailable. This is not an extension context.
warnNoExtensionContext.description: Shown when the popup document was opened outside the extension.

warnProfileUnreadable.message: Could not read the folder $PATH$, so whether the extension is installed in this profile is unknown.
warnProfileUnreadable.description: Shown when a profile directory listing failed.

warnDirUnreadable.description: Shown when a sub-directory listing failed.

warnNoLevelDbFiles.description: Shown when the storage directory exists but is empty.

warnLevelDbUnreadable.message: Could not read the LevelDB in $PATH$ ($DETAIL$).
warnLevelDbUnreadable.description: Shown when the parser failed outright.

warnParserNote.description: A note from the LevelDB parser. The detail is the parser's own English diagnostic and is not translated.

detail.example: CURRENT is missing; scanning every table and log

warnProfileRead.description: Shown when reading one profile threw.

warnLocalState.message: Could not read Local State in $PATH$: $DETAIL$
warnLocalState.description: Shown when the file holding profile names and emails could not be read.

warnBadJson.description: Shown when a value on disk does not parse as JSON.

warnBadJsonRaw.message: $KEY$ is not valid JSON ($DETAIL$). Using the raw value.
warnBadJsonRaw.description: Shown when the JSON is broken but the raw value looks like a UUID.

warnNotUuid.message: $KEY$ does not look like a UUID: $VALUE$
warnNotUuid.description: Shown when the value was read but is not UUID-shaped.

warnNotJsonString.description: Shown when the value is some other JSON type.

privacyNote.message: cici only reads files on this computer. Nothing is ever sent anywhere.
privacyNote.description: Footnote at the bottom of the popup.
